description: Generate branded per-page Open Graph (social share) cards for a website: a 1200×630 JPEG ≤300 KB for every page, rendered by a committed Python+Pillow script and wired so each page sets its own `image=` (with a default fallback) and the test suite proves the card exists at the right size. Use when building or auditing a site's share previews — "OG image", "og:image", "social share image", "share card", "WhatsApp/Slack/LinkedIn preview", "Twitter card image", "the picture when I share the link", "per-page OG images", "generate share images". For general marketing image creation/optimization use the `image` skill; this one is specifically the build-time, tested, per-page card generator for the suite's Astro starter.
